```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {debyeLength, debyeNumber, powerOfTen, formatSci} from "./plasma.js"
blue = "#0072B2"
orange = "#B55000"
ink = "#17202A"
shade = "#EEF1F4"
// Drawing units of a 257 mm wide slide area at 970 px: 24 px = 18 pt body text.
font = ({fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "19px", color: ink, background: "transparent"})
// Plot text is plain: draw "λ_D" and "n^-1/3" with sub- and superscripts.
subscripts = (svg) => {
  for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll("text")) {
    if (!/[_^]/.test(t.textContent)) continue;
    t.innerHTML = t.textContent
      .replace(/_(\w+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>')
      .replace(/\^(\S+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>');
  }
  return svg;
}
length = (m) => {
  const units = [[1e3, "km"], [1, "m"], [1e-3, "mm"], [1e-6, "µm"], [1e-9, "nm"], [1e-12, "pm"]];
  const [s, u] = units.find(([s]) => m >= s) ?? units.at(-1);
  return `${Number((m / s).toPrecision(2))} ${u}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
lambda = debyeLength(n, T)
a = Math.cbrt(1 / n)
N_D = debyeNumber(n, T)
radii = d3.range(0, 360.01).map((i) => 10 ** (-10 + 12 * i / 360))
```

```{ojs}
subscripts(Plot.plot({
  width: 970, height: 480, marginLeft: 70, marginRight: 14, marginTop: 44, marginBottom: 48,
  style: font, clip: true,
  x: {type: "log", domain: [1e-10, 1e2], label: "r [m]", labelAnchor: "right", labelArrow: "none",
      ticks: d3.range(-10, 3, 2).map((k) => 10 ** k), tickFormat: powerOfTen, grid: true},
  y: {domain: [0, 1.15], label: "4πε_0 r Φ / e", labelArrow: "none", ticks: [0, 0.5, 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect([0], {x1: 1e-10, x2: a, y1: 0, y2: 1.15, fill: shade}),
    Plot.text(a > 1e-8 ? [0] : [], {x: a, y: 0.05, text: () => "r < n_e^−1/3", textAnchor: "end", dx: -6, fill: "#526175"}),
    Plot.ruleY([1], {stroke: orange, strokeDasharray: "8,5", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.text([0], {x: 6e1, y: 1, text: () => "bare", dy: -12, textAnchor: "end", fill: orange}),
    Plot.line(radii, {x: (r) => r, y: (r) => Math.exp(-r / lambda), stroke: blue, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.ruleX([lambda], {y1: 0, y2: 1.07, stroke: ink, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.text([lambda], {x: (d) => d, y: 1.12, text: () => `λ_D = ${length(lambda)}`, fill: ink, fontSize: 24}),
  ],
}))
```

<div class="readout" id="ND"></div>

```{ojs}
//| output: false
document.getElementById("ND").innerHTML = `N<sub>D</sub> = ${formatSci(N_D, 2)}`
document.getElementById("ND").classList.toggle("warn", N_D < 1)
```

```{ojs}
viewof n = Inputs.range([1e6, 1e30], {value: 1e20, transform: Math.log, step: 0.01,
  label: html`<i>n</i><sub>e</sub>`})
viewof T = Inputs.range([0.1, 1e5], {value: 1e4, transform: Math.log, step: 0.01,
  label: html`<i>k</i><sub>B</sub><i>T</i><sub>e</sub>`})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Slider values with units; the number box of Inputs.range cannot show 10²⁰.
{
  for (const [view, v, unit] of [[viewof n, n, "m⁻³"], [viewof T, T, "eV"]]) {
    const div = view.querySelector("div");
    const out = div.querySelector("output") ?? div.appendChild(document.createElement("output"));
    out.textContent = `${formatSci(v, 2)} ${unit}`;
  }
}
```
